dog.description_text:
From the moment you meet him, it’s clear how Freckles got his name—his adorable speckled face is as unique as his heart is big!

Rescued from a municipal shelter in North Carolina, Freckles is now looking for a forever home to call his own. This sweet and loving boy is incredibly friendly and has a gentle spirit that makes him a joy to be around.

🦴 People Friendly

🐶 Dog Friendly

🐱 Cat Friendly: Unknown, but we’re happy to test!

Freckles would be a wonderful addition to any household. Whether you’re a first-time adopter or looking to add another pup to your pack, he’s ready to fill your life with love, tail wags, and companionship.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
